actions: Release the power box (if it is clipped on) and the vent hose
Remove the hold-down and lift the battery out
canonicalStep.title: trunk-battery-compartment (BMW 328i draft Battery Replacement guide; evidence step 4, 5, 6, 7, 8)

elements.describe: A single 12 V battery on the right side of the luggage compartment, under the trunk cover/panel.
A distribution box attached to the top of the battery (BMW calls it the rear power distribution box; its fuse links cannot be replaced individually).
The negative battery post with its clamp; the intelligent battery sensor is part of the negative lead. Do not disturb the sensor.
A cover over the positive terminal on the battery top (a red cover is described on an E82 post).
A vent hose leading from the battery's vent port; routing in the trunk is not established.
A metal hold-down plate/bracket that clamps the battery; exact position and number of fasteners not established beyond one M6 collar screw in the catalog.
Unestablished detail of vent hose: Routing path and clip positions on the E90 sedan are not established.
Unestablished detail of hold down bracket: Exact shape and number of fasteners are not established beyond catalog part list.
